lines.speaker: MIRA?
lines.text: Daniel? I'm right here. Just follow my voice.

lines.speaker: EVELYN?
lines.text: It's safe now. You can come out.

lines.speaker: MARCUS?
lines.text: Arlen. Stay where you are. I'm coming to you.

lines.speaker: MIRA?
lines.text: Please. Please don't leave me alone down here.

newGamePlus.speaker: DANIEL?
newGamePlus.text: Daniel. Whatever happens. Do not open the door.
